steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...In other words, NOX's body houses tens of thousands of souls of the dead.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Numerous minds have fused together and lost their essential sanity, leaving only the last bit of survival instinct to drive their actions.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: And that girl...
She's the only person I've seen not appearing as a shadow in NOX's spiritual space. What's more, the shadow's activity is suppressed around her as well.
She's very likely the core that many of the dead attach to, the original owner of that body.
The Grim Reaper NOX is undoubtedly an immense threat to other Sinners and even to the MBCC.
But if we can confirm that girl—NOX's main personality—is not a threat, then we can try to guide her to regain control over her body.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I understand what you mean, but...
Nightingale is a little hesitant.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This is already the fourth attempt to connect to NOX's consciousness. Repeated contact with a highly contaminated Sinner like her will be a massive burden on your mind.
I have my own judgment.
Nightingale gives a sigh.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Lakeside Residence was a sanatorium built in N.F. 61 which served patients with chronic illnesses, located in the scenic area three hundred meters from the south coast of DisSea. Much data was lost after the explosion of DisSea, so we couldn't retrieve information about the girl.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But based on your description, her ward should be in the intensive care area on the sixth floor. The fire escape on the first floor's west side leads straight there. You can evade attacks from most of the shadows if you take that path.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But above all, remember who you are—${PlayerName}, The Chief of MBCC. Please never forget this.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: And...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Best of luck to you.
On the other side of the glass, NOX is as silent as a corpse. You take a deep breath and wrap up your mental preparation.

options: Use the shackles to create a link

choices.text: Use the shackles to create a link

steps.content: <size=31>Damp wind blowing in your face, you're back to that lakeside. Like the past few times, the dead's messages lingering here are flying toward you like air blades, attempting to occupy your mind—but thanks to the repeated self reminders in the preparation, you immediately recall your identity and objective.</size>

The gathering shadows have never left, still loitering around. You sneak into the sanatorium swiftly and carefully pass through the lobby and corridors following Nightingale's hints, not startling any of the shadows.
Finally, you arrive at the door of the young girl's ward.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Come in.
The girl's voice pierces through the door. Without hesitation, you push open the door and enter.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: You're the new caretaker, right?
You close the door behind you. After what happened last time, the ward has become shabbier. Some shadows remain in the ward, but luckily they're much more tamed than the ones outside.
To avoid rousing these irrational, grudging souls, without batting an eye, you start pretending to be the caretaker the girl has mentioned.
Do you need anything from me?

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: The previous caretaker had cleaned before leaving. I'm not hungry either...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: You can take a break for now. I'll let you know if I need anything.
After a wordless moment, the girl casts her glance outside the window again, but all she finds there are the red moon and incessant roars.
Not sure if caused by the cold or fear, the girl's body has been trembling the whole time.
How long have you been here?
The girl turns back.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Six years.
The girl pauses, then murmurs.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: ...So it's already been six years.
Your condition...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Systemic muscle fibrosis caused by abnormal crystal hyperplasia in soft tissues—according to the doctor.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I don't understand it fully either, I only know it's very, very rare. It's said that there have only been two cases in the whole DisCity.
It must have caused you a lot of inconvenience.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Indeed, a few years ago, I couldn't even stand up on my own...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: But it's improved a lot, now I can walk around in the ward with the caretaker's help.
The girl's smile is cheerful, although the actual situation may not be as hopeful as it sounds.
You scan the surroundings and find that the bouquet on the nightstand has already withered. Beneath the flowers, a thick pile of letters stands out particularly.
Are those from your friends?

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Yes, most of them are from my friends from school.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Here.
Without a hint of annoyance, the girl smiles and passes the letters to you.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: ...Read them yourself.
Sensing your hesitation, she passes the letters to you casually.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: It's fine, I don't mind.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: It's been too long, I don't quite remember what they wrote.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: These past two years, my eyes... haven't been able to see very clearly. Could you read them to me, please?
You smile and take the letters, unfolding the paper.
However, the content of all the letters is covered by some kind of somber dark gray mist, as if something is stopping the girl from recalling the past.
Unable to read the blank letters for the girl, you hold up the stack of letters silently. After a long while, the girl lowers her head, a little disappointed.
They... Your friends have never visited you here?

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: They have.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: They brought those flowers.
On the bare stems, several scattered dried petals and leaves are hanging.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: They used to come more often, but recently...
The girl has grown even sadder.

You notice the shadows in the ward becoming more active gradually, floating around in the room aimlessly. Every time a shadow passes through the girl's body, a shiver arises in her, and the room grows even chillier.

options: Try to expel them with the shackles

choices.text: Try to expel them with the shackles

steps.content: The shackles' power manages to stun the stirring shadows. They've retreated to the dark corners of the ward.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: ...It's fine, really. Sometimes I feel frustrated too, worried I may never see them again.
A smile reemerges on the girl's face, apparently completely oblivious of the shadows' existence and your actions.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: But as long as I can still see the sunrise, I can keep going.
Sunrise?

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: You've never seen it, have you?
The girl seems a little excited.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: A warm morning sun that leaps out of the lake.
The girl glances at the slightly dry pale blonde hair lying on her shoulder.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: They don't look alike anymore... But in the past, it looked just like the color of my hair.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Every time I see it, it cheers me up and makes me believe I will live on. Suddenly, my illness, all the medicine and all the treatments don't seem that scary anymore.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: It's a pity the weather hasn't been very nice these days, otherwise you can see it too. It's really pretty!
The girl looks out the window again. In the pitch-black sky, besides the icy red moon, there's nothing else.
I'm sure you'll get to see it, the sun always rises. When it does, I'll take you to see it.
You comfort the girl.
But there's no sun in this dark, hopeless place.
Have you ever thought about... leaving this place?

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Leaving?
The girl looks confused.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I must stay here to nurse my illness...
You've stayed here for a long time. Have you never thought about going out for a walk sometimes?

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: But the doctor said...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: No, it seems that I... That's true, why haven't I...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I really miss my friends a lot. Now that I can move around... I should go visit them...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: How weird... How come I can't even recall their names...
As the girl is mumbling to herself, the shadows in the corners have become agitated again.
They lean into the girl's ears and whisper unsettling words.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Must live on...

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Don't want to go back...
The girl's wavering thoughts create cracks on the already worn walls of the ward. More shadows are swarming in, charging at you, the intruder.

You try hard to suppress them with the shackles, but the number of shadows has far exceeded what you can handle. Under their tearing and biting, your headache and chaotic thoughts, which should not happen in this ward, suddenly reappear.
Time is running out, you must ask the critical question—this is also the most crucial purpose of your visit.
I have a question for you.
The girl turns her head, looking confused. The colors in her indigo eyes are fading, you must hurry up.
If there's a way that will allow you to live properly, enable you to move freely, and free you from being bound to the sickbed.
But the price is that you must kill others, take their lives, will you do it?

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: How can I do that!
The girl shouts out her answer.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: That is not right, Mr.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: How can I take others' lives in order to... to...
The girl's face is flushed from her emotions, and she sounds a little incoherent. Her answer gives you confidence that what you're doing is indeed right.
But what she says next makes your heart tighten.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Hold on... I think I've had certain dreams... I...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I killed many people in those dreams... They didn't want to... But still I...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: That's not right... How could I... That's not right...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: That's not right, I don't want that, I must leave this place...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Argh!
The girl is screaming. On the corners of the ward, cracks suddenly appear out of nowhere, and shadows are rushing in from all directions, shouting next to the girl's ears.

steps.speaker: Dark Shadow
steps.content: I don't want to die!

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: You can't leave!

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: We've made a promise!

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Kill him... Kill him!

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I don't want that!
The girl struggles and gets up, shakes off the shadows next to her, and staggers out of the ward through the door.
You didn't expect the question to cause such a big stir. You want to stop the escaping girl but instead get dragged by countless shadows, rendering you powerless.
With the girl gone, the small ward collapses within seconds. All the memories, except for the letters you're gripping tightly, are buried in darkness.
You release the shackles' power with all your might, and the shadows dragging you get blown away, wailing.
You begin to fall.
Fall...
Fall.
You fall through the deaths of countless people, witnessing all the past memories and deaths.
Longing, bitterness, pain, despair. All emotions vanish with death, turning into endless madness.
But as you keep falling, the dark gray mist on the letters in your hands is slowly fading too. You see the girl's stolen life, see the countless blessings, and see... a name.
You need to save her, you need to help that girl take back her own life.
